regions.today: Warm and dry for the rest of today with long sunny spells in light easterly or variable breezes. Winds will increase moderate at times near the south and southeast coasts.
regions.tonight: Mild, dry and largely clear tonight in light variable breezes. A few isolated fog patches may form. Temperatures will not fall below 14 to 17 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Warm or very warm and dry tomorrow, Tuesday, with long spells of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 24 to 28 or 29 degrees in light westerly breezes. A little cooler near coasts, where an onshore breeze will develop.
regions.pollen: Very high on Tuesday and Wednesday.
regions.solar_uv: High to very high on Tuesday. High on Wednesday.
